name: Upload input surface
purpose: Owns the input-side surface of the file-upload contract: the labelled file input, the drop-zone region, the keyboard-focusable picker-opener, the accessible-name binding, the file-collector aggregating the three input paths into one selection set, and the refusal-render seam. Every AC on REQ-001 and REQ-003 that reads the surface anchors on this TAC.
responsibilities: Render a labelled <input type="file"> with a keyboard-reachable label and an accessible name (AC-23101-1).
Render a [data-drop-zone] region that accepts dropped files but is never the only input path (WCAG 2.5.7).
Render a [data-open-picker] button that opens the same picker on Enter or Space (AC-23101-1).
Aggregate the three input paths into one file-selection set the transport TAC drains (AC-23101-1).

Render a per-file error region with an aria-describedby binding and a [data-recovery="retry"] control on refusal, and hand refused files to the transport TAC's refusal-render seam so no bytes leave the browser (AC-23103-1).

applyElicits: at apply time, dispatch each of the six answer families to its owner interface: `accepted-set` and `size-cap` populate the input gate; `tick-interval` binds `TAC-2403.interfaces.tickInterval`; `concurrency` binds the transport chunk parallelism on `TAC-2402`; `polling` binds `TAC-2403.interfaces.announcementInterval`; `chunked-transport` selects the transport branch on `TAC-2402`. Per REQ-006 (AC-23106-1 through AC-23108-1).

verifyVirusScan: call the applied virus-scan verifier as an async predicate over each collected File; on `{clean: false, reason}` route the file to `interfaces.renderRefusal`, ensuring no bytes leave the browser. The blueprint provides the `virusScan` capability that names this verifier hook. Per REQ-007 (AC-23103-1).
internalStructure: One input-surface module the shell mounts on route entry. On file addition the module normalises the three input paths (input change, drop event, picker-opener button) into a File[] selection set, tags each entry with a stable [data-file-row] id, runs the accepted-set gates (MIME per ADR-2402, size per ADR-2402) and the virus-scan hook per ADR-2403 before handing the set to the transport TAC. Refusal renders inside the file row with a [data-error-message] element whose id is referenced by the row's aria-describedby attribute; the closed refusal-reason enum {mime-refused, size-refused, virus-refused} rides [data-refusal-reason].

interfaces.name: collectFiles
interfaces.description: collectFiles({ inputEvent | dropEvent | pickerClick }) -> FileSelection. Every input path routes through this factory.

interfaces.name: renderRefusal
interfaces.description: renderRefusal({ fileRow, reason }) -> void. Binds the error region to the row via aria-describedby, sets [data-refusal-reason], focuses the [data-recovery="retry"] control.

interfaces.name: affordancesEnum
interfaces.description: The three input affordances (input, drop-zone, keyboard-opener) are the closed enum {file-input, drop-zone, keyboard-opener}. Removing one is a v2.0.0 major bump.

dependencies.name: Transport contract
dependencies.description: The input surface hands accepted files to the transport TAC and honours its refusal-render seam on virus-scan hits.

tradeoffs: One input-surface module keeps the WCAG 2.5.7 discipline lint-checkable but ties every framework to the collectFiles factory. Projects using a vendor upload widget (Filepond, Uppy) satisfy the surface by adapting the vendor's mount seam to the TAC's factories rather than rewriting the collector. Known mechanism-reach gap: the pack cannot exhaustively probe every drop-target inside a nested drop-zone; the primary drop-zone attribute is asserted.
notes: See README Known mechanism-reach gaps for the full list.
